_about: 曼城 2024/25 英超是否进前四的冻结证据包。信息截至 2024-08-01。

evidence.title: All 380 fixtures for 2024/25 Premier League season
evidence.excerpt: The 2024/25 Premier League fixtures have been released and the dates of all 380 matches are below.
evidence.claim: 截点前英超官方已公布 2024/25 完整赛程，赛季结构确定。

evidence.title: 2024/25 Premier League fixtures announced today
evidence.excerpt: The Premier League have confirmed that the fixture schedule for the 2024/25 season will be revealed this Tuesday 18 June 2024.
evidence.claim: 俱乐部官方确认赛季安排，截点前四连冠的曼城进入新赛季；页面未标注发布日。
